rules.name: API1: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
rules.description: Detects sequential or unauthorized access to API objects by ID indicating broken object-level authorization
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("bola" OR "idor" OR "authorization")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API2: Broken Authentication — Default Credentials
rules.description: Detects API authentication attempts using default or well-known credentials
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("authentication" OR "default-credentials" OR "brute-force")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API3: Broken Object Property Level Authorization (BOPLA)
rules.description: Detects API responses returning sensitive properties that the user should not access
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("bopla" OR "property-level" OR "authorization")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API4: Unrestricted Resource Consumption — Rate Limiting
rules.description: Detects API requests exceeding rate limits indicating denial of service or scraping attacks
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("rate-limiting" OR "resource-consumption" OR "dos")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API5: Broken Function Level Authorization
rules.description: Detects access to administrative API endpoints by non-administrative users
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("flba" OR "privilege-escalation" OR "authorization")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API6: Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
rules.description: Detects automated or excessive access to business-critical API flows like checkout, transfer, or account creation
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("business-flows" OR "automation" OR "abuse")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API7: Server-Side Request Forgery via API
rules.description: Detects SSRF attempts through API endpoints targeting internal networks or cloud metadata
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("ssrf" OR "server-side" OR "injection")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API8: Security Misconfiguration — Exposed API Documentation
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to API documentation endpoints like Swagger, OpenAPI, or GraphQL introspection
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("misconfiguration" OR "swagger" OR "documentation")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API9: Improper Inventory Management — Shadow API
rules.description: Detects access to undocumented or deprecated API endpoints not in the API inventory
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("shadow-api" OR "inventory" OR "misconfiguration")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API10: Unsafe Consumption of API Responses
rules.description: Detects API responses containing executable content or unsafe data that could harm downstream systems
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("unsafe-consumption" OR "response-handling" OR "injection")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API — Mass Assignment via Parameter Tampering
rules.description: Detects mass assignment attacks where request parameters include unauthorized fields like role, isAdmin, or status
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("mass-assignment" OR "parameter-tampering" OR "authorization")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API — GraphQL Query Depth Attack
rules.description: Detects GraphQL queries with excessive depth or complexity indicating DoS or data extraction
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("graphql" OR "dos" OR "abuse")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API — JWT Token None Algorithm Attack
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with algorithm set to none or missing algorithm indicating authentication bypass
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("jwt" OR "algorithm-none" OR "authentication")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API — Excessive Data Exposure in Response
rules.description: Detects API responses returning more data than requested including PII, credentials, or internal fields
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("data-exposure" OR "pii" OR "over-fetching")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API — NoSQL Injection in Request Parameters
rules.description: Detects NoSQL injection operators ($where, $regex, $gt) in API request parameters
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("nosql-injection" OR "injection" OR "mongodb")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: API — Broken Access Control on API Keys
rules.description: Detects API key usage from unauthorized sources or with excessive permissions
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("api-keys" OR "access-control" OR "authorization")
author: SIEM Alert Rules
